scope.purpose: Show a short text about a control when the user points at it or focuses it.
useCases: The keyboard shortcut of an action.
A short clarification of a truncated label.
exclusions: Interactive or essential content: Popover or text on the page.
Rich tooltips with titles or images.

contract.scope: Tooltip contract: required label, side top/bottom, align, bindable open; trigger Button, IconButton or Link; inverse surface, caption.md, component tokens component.tooltip.delay (500 ms) and component.tooltip.max-inline-size (240 px); focus opens at once; accessible description; top layer.
contract.provenance: User at the grouped wave 3 contract gate in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c543GZBnpgBmqmSNfDLB (2026-11-03), on the review page https://claude.ai/artifact/3WoVBXoZev2vBWUUJny9A8 (version 3): "Je valide les 10 contrats. Ensuite : 1. ok (meme si le wording scrim n'est pas très parlant...) 2. Ok 3. Ok 4. Oui 5. Ok, à juger dans l'implémentation".

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Inverse surface (color.surface.inverse, color.content.inverse), typography.caption.md, radius.control, padding space.content.sm × xs, max inline size component.tooltip.max-inline-size (component token, 240 px).
Side top or bottom (what lib/overlay positions today), align center by default; flips and shifts; no arrow.
Hover delay component.tooltip.delay (component token, 500 ms); focus opens at once; once one tooltip is open, the next opens at once.
Accessible description of the trigger, except when the text equals an IconButton's name.
Trigger restricted to Button, IconButton and Link (focusable components); other content gets a Popover or visible text.
nextAction: Implementation phase (ggb-svelte): component folder, examples page, SSR and browser tests, self-contained preview; Firefox and WebKit smoke projects before the first overlay implementation gate; then the grouped wave 3 implementation review.
